about: MT4-6 router eval. 30 cases. 'statuses' override the default profile (ocr_image, transcribe_audio, speak ready; every other model tool needsDownload). 'expected.tool' null = no tool needed; 'accept' lists other first-tool names counted correct ('none' = answering directly). 'expected.args' maps an argument to substrings, any of which (case-insensitive) must appear in the router's value. 'example' is a perfect router's arguments: the CI checks it against the tool's schema and against 'expected.args'. 'knownPolicyGap' marks a case ToolExposurePolicy is known to miss today (a measurement, not a fix); 'gapWithoutGate' = it misses even with gateAmbiguousTools off (the generator cues are not behind the gate).
